title: Application Health
description: Request throughput, latency, and HTTP error rates for the four instrumented application services (checkout-service, payment-service, inventory-service, notification-service), plus checkout-service's outbound dependency calls. All queries run against Prometheus metrics scraped from the OTel Collector's application-metrics relay (job="otel-collector-app-metrics") — verified empirically against real checkout traffic, not assumed. A panel showing no data means no matching traffic occurred in the selected time range, not a fabricated zero.

panels.title: Request Throughput by Service
panels.description: sum by (service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-app-metrics"}[$__rate_interval])) — HTTP server requests/sec per service, all routes and status codes combined. Empty for a service with no requests in range (not shown as 0).

panels.title: Request Latency (p50 / p95) by Service
panels.description: histogram_quantile over http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket, summed by (le, service_name). All four services share identical OTel SDK default histogram boundaries (5ms–10s), confirmed empirically, so p95 is directly comparable across services. No data for a service/quantile combination means too few samples in range for that bucket set, not a zero-latency claim.

panels.title: HTTP Error Rate by Service (4xx / 5xx)
panels.description: sum by (service_name) (rate(..._count{http_response_status_code=~"4.."|"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) — split into client-error (4xx) and server-error (5xx) request rates using the real http_response_status_code label (confirmed populated, e.g. a genuine 400 from an invalid checkout request). Under normal operation this is expected to be near-zero/no-data: every service's simulated business logic currently always succeeds deterministically, so 5xx is not expected in practice — this panel does not synthesize failures to demonstrate itself.

panels.title: Checkout Downstream Dependency Traffic
panels.description: sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="checkout-service"}[$__rate_interval])) — checkout-service's own outbound HTTP client calls to payment-service, inventory-service, and notification-service (POST /checkouts synchronously calls all three). Scoped to service_name="checkout-service" specifically so notification-service's own unrelated outbound OTLP-export HTTP client calls (also instrumented, but not a business dependency) are excluded.

panels.title: Checkout Downstream Dependency Latency (p95)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="checkout-service"}[$__rate_interval]))) — how long checkout-service's own calls to each downstream service take, from the caller's perspective (includes network + the downstream server's own processing time).
